Title: [LSJ] Secret Library of Alexandria and action modifiers question

Messages.Author: Doug
Messages.Body:
A question came up in one of our games tonight. I was being bled by a
!Nos whose methuselah had a Secret Library of Alexandria in play. I
didn't block, the bleed was successful and the other guy drew his card
for the Secret Library. The card drawn with the Secret Library was a
Dirty Little Secrets. The question was can he legally play the DLS on
the just completed bleed? How about if the card was a Freak Drive and
the vampire had fortitude? We were figuring that the timing window
for the DLS would be similar to Freak Drive.

I'm pretty sure that it is okay to play a modifer like Freak Drive or
DLS if it is drawn with the Secret Library. My interpretation is that
the draw and discard down to hand size happens during action
resolution, which is the same time window that Freak Drive or DLS
would be played.

I tried to search the Google archives on this and didn't come up with
anything. I thought was odd considering how many Nos vamps have
fortitude. I would have figured that the Freak Drive portion of the
question would have come up before.

Thanks
Doug

Slightly before Freak Drive - Both DLS and SLoA activate at the successful
resolution of the bleed. Freak Drive activates after.

> I'm pretty sure that it is okay to play a modifer like Freak Drive or
> DLS if it is drawn with the Secret Library.

Correct.
